title: Looks Plural, Takes Singular Verb
notes:
📚 School Subjects / Science

  • Physics is
  • Mathematics is
  • Economics is
  • Genetics is
  • Robotics is

🎲 Games / Sports

  • Darts is
  • Billiards is
  • Dominoes is
  • Gymnastics is

🌍 Countries / Places

  • The United States is
  • The Netherlands is
  • The Philippines is
  • Headquarters is

💰 Measurement Units (Time / Money / Distance)

  • Ten dollars is
  • Five miles is
  • Three hours is

📰 Other Words

  • News is
  • Series is
  • Species is
  • Crossroads is

Note: species and series are number-neutral — use a singular or plural verb according to meaning (e.g. this species is rare / these species are rare).

💡 Quick Example Sentences

  • The news is good.
  • The United States is big.
summary: Words ending in -s that still use 'is/was'.
